parsed.degree_signal: PhD / Master in a relevant field (Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning) — exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome.
parsed.notes:
ABOUT YOU defaults to required; NICE TO HAVE makes its items optional. Technologies appearing only in the company description or responsibilities are excluded.
Training and fine-tuning are read literally as alternative technical practices, mapped to model-development and fine-tuning.
Large language models and tabular foundation models are alternative model families, but the latter and its TabPFN example have no taxonomy entries; no singleton alternative_group is emitted for llms.
Text-to-SQL, table question answering, and spreadsheet agents are alternatives; only agents maps to the taxonomy, so no singleton alternative_group is emitted.
Text-to-SQL is not treated as a separate standalone SQL requirement; SQL is independently required in ABOUT YOU.
Typing is read literally as code typing, not inferred to mean TypeScript. Query execution is an example of a verifiable reward, not a separate candidate skill.
Expertise, independence, and a track record of success do not provide a permitted seniority signal.
The degree takes the highest named level. Welcoming other backgrounds does not explicitly specify equivalent experience or a comparable qualification.
